properties.name: The read side of the graph is specified as a contract — `ifc:graph-read`, five operations derived by counting every call site in reflow2-core, with its exclusions and its error model written down. Provided by cmp:graph, consumed by the 16 modules measured to read the store and never write it. This is step 1 of making a module swappable, independently testable and independently optimisable: the spec is the test of whether the boundary is real, and it comes before any Rust.
